title: Capital Lighting Round Wooden Chandelier - 430501UW - Size: Large - Color: Beige
text: Rustic and weathered for extra character. The Round Wooden Chandelier by Capital Lighting offers a distinct farmhouse aesthetic that will add intrigue to any space in the home. Its handcrafted ring-shaped base is comprised of reclaimed wood that is hand-finished, making each fixture unique. Lining the top of the ring is a metal accent, which supports the series of candle holders and bulbs that emit a warm, ambient glow. This fixture is ideal for adding a fresh, industrial element to kitchens, dining rooms, or living rooms. Shape: Round. Color: Beige. Finish: Urban Wash
